title: The Musicians

questions.question: Who did David and the chiefs of the service separate for the service?
options: The sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun
questions.correctAnswer: The sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:1 (ESV): "David and the chiefs of the service also separated for the service the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun..."

questions.question: What did they prophesy with?
options: Lyres, with harps, and with cymbals
questions.correctAnswer: Lyres, with harps, and with cymbals
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:1 (ESV): "...who prophesy with lyres, with harps, and with cymbals..."

questions.question: Under whose direction were the sons of Asaph?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:2 (ESV): "...under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied under the direction of the king."

questions.question: How many sons did Heman have?
How many daughters did Heman have?
What title was given to Heman?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:5 (ESV): "All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer..."

questions.question: What was the total number of those trained in singing to the LORD?
How many men were in each division?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:9 (ESV): "...Joseph: he and his sons and his brothers were twelve..." (Repeated for each lot).

questions.question: How were duties assigned between small and great, teacher and pupil?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:8 (ESV): "And they cast lots for their duties, small and great, teacher and pupil alike."

questions.question: To whom did the first lot fall?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:9 (ESV): "The first lot fell for Asaph to Joseph..."

questions.question: To whom did the second lot fall?
Whose sons were Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:3 (ESV): "Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah..."

questions.question: What is the number of Jeduthun's sons listed (including the one added by tradition/context to make six)?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:3 (ESV): "...six, under the direction of their father Jeduthun..." Note: Some manuscripts list Shimei, making the count six.

questions.question: To whom did the twenty-fourth lot fall?

key_verse_text: The number of them along with their brothers, who were trained in singing to the LORD, all who were skillful, was 288.
